faqs.question: How long does the review process take?
faqs.answer: Our team typically reviews submissions within 2–3 business days. You will receive a notification once your project is approved or if we need more information.

faqs.question: What happens if a project does not reach its goal?
faqs.answer: Projects that do not reach their funding goal can still keep the funds raised. We encourage founders to be transparent with supporters about how funds will be used.

faqs.question: Is there a fee to use Sahmi?
faqs.answer: Creating a project is free. We only charge a small platform fee on successfully funded projects to keep the platform running.

faqs.question: How do I know projects are legitimate?
faqs.answer: Every project goes through our verification process. We verify the founder, review the business plan, and confirm transparency standards before a project goes live.

about.meaning: Sahmi — meaning “my share” in Arabic — is a crowdfunding platform built to empower Palestinian entrepreneurs and connect them with a global community of supporters.
about.missionText: To provide Palestinian entrepreneurs with a trustworthy, transparent platform to raise funds, build community support, and turn their ideas into reality. We believe every great idea deserves a chance and every community deserves access to opportunity.
about.visionText: A thriving Palestinian entrepreneurial ecosystem where innovation flourishes, communities prosper, and supporters worldwide can play a meaningful role in creating positive change.
about.journeyTitle: Building Hope, One Project at a Time
about.journeyText1: Sahmi was born from a simple belief: Palestinian entrepreneurs deserve access to the resources they need to bring their visions to life. In a world full of challenges, we saw an opportunity to create bridges between innovative minds and caring supporters.
about.journeyText2: Today, we have helped hundreds of projects find their footing, creating a ripple effect of positive change far beyond the initial funding. Each success story reflects the resilience and creativity of Palestinian entrepreneurs.
about.valuesText: The principles that guide everything we do at Sahmi.
about.reviewText1: Every project submitted to Sahmi undergoes a careful review. Our team verifies the founder, reviews the business plan and funding allocation, and confirms that transparency standards are met.
about.reviewText2: Only projects that pass our comprehensive review are listed. This protects entrepreneurs and supporters and builds a trustworthy ecosystem for everyone.
about.testimonial: Sahmi gave us more than funding—it gave us a community that believed in our vision. The transparency and support made all the difference in bringing our project to life.
about.ctaText: Whether you are an entrepreneur with a vision or a supporter looking to create impact, Sahmi is your platform.

contact.faqText: Everything you need to know about using Sahmi.

faqs.question: How do I start a project on Sahmi?
faqs.answer: Select “Start Your Project” and follow the simple five-step form. Our team will review your submission within 2–3 business days.

faqs.question: Is my contribution secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Transactions are processed through secure payment providers using bank-level encryption.

faqs.question: What happens if a project does not reach its goal?
faqs.answer: If a project does not reach its minimum funding goal, contributions are returned to supporters in full.

faqs.question: How are projects verified?
faqs.answer: Our team verifies the founder, reviews the business plan, and checks funding allocations before listing a project.

faqs.question: Can I invest from outside Palestine?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sahmi connects Palestinian entrepreneurs with supporters worldwide, so you can contribute from wherever you are.

faqs.question: How do I contact project founders?
faqs.answer: Each project page includes messaging. You can also contact our support team with any questions.

contact.stillText: Cannot find the answer you need? Our team is happy to help.
contact.ctaText: Join thousands of supporters and entrepreneurs creating positive change in Palestinian communities.
contact.globalText: Our team speaks Arabic and English and supports users around the world. Wherever you are, we are here for you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: This policy explains what information the Sahmi platform may collect, why it is used, and the choices available to users.

1.title: Information we collect
1.body:
We may collect account details such as your name, email address, phone number, account type, and password credentials. Entrepreneurs may also submit project descriptions, budgets, timelines, images, and supporting documents.

The platform may record investments, messages, notifications, project activity, and basic technical data needed to operate and secure the application.

2.title: How we use information
2.body: Information is used to create and manage accounts, display projects, record funding activity, support communication, review project submissions, provide dashboards, and maintain the security and reliability of the platform.

3.title: Project information and documents
3.body: Information published on a project page may be visible to other platform users. Sensitive documents submitted for administrative review should only be accessible to authorized administrators. Do not upload banking information, trade secrets, or material that is not appropriate for the platform.

4.title: Sharing and disclosure
4.body: Sahmi does not sell personal information. Data may be visible to other users where required by platform features, shared with service providers needed to run the platform, or disclosed when necessary to address security issues or comply with applicable requirements.

5.title: Storage and security
5.body: Reasonable technical safeguards are used, including access controls and password protection. However, no system is guaranteed to be completely secure. Users should avoid submitting unnecessary sensitive data and should use a password that is not reused on other services.

6.title: Retention
6.body: Platform data may be retained while it is needed to provide the service, meet operational requirements, and maintain audit records. Records may be corrected, anonymized, or deleted when they are no longer needed.

7.title: Your choices
7.body: You may review or update supported profile information through your account settings. You may also request correction or deletion of account data by contacting the project owner. Some records may remain temporarily in backups or audit logs.

8.title: Contact us
8.body: For privacy questions or requests, email ikryyemala@gmail.com or contact the Sahmi project team in Khan Yunis, Hounain Street, Gaza, Palestine.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.introduction: These terms describe the rules for accessing and using the Sahmi platform. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to follow them.

1.title: Platform scope
1.body: Sahmi provides project, funding, communication, approval, and reporting workflows. Nothing displayed on the platform constitutes financial, legal, or investment advice or a binding commitment unless separately documented and agreed by authorized parties.

2.title: Eligibility and accounts
2.body: You must provide accurate account information, keep your credentials secure, and use the correct account role. You are responsible for activity performed through your account and should notify the project team if you suspect unauthorized access.

3.title: Project submissions
3.body: Entrepreneurs are responsible for the accuracy and appropriateness of submitted project content. New projects and edits may require administrator approval before publication. Approval within the platform is not professional verification, endorsement, or a guarantee of project success.

4.title: Funding and Return of Investment
4.body: Funding amounts are recorded by the platform. Project funds are not released until the displayed funding goal reaches 100%. Implementation timelines represent work after full funding. Any Return of Investment schedule begins only after implementation is complete and the project is operating.

5.title: User content and communication
5.body: You retain responsibility for content you submit. You permit Sahmi to store and display that content as needed to provide platform features. Messages must be respectful, relevant, and free from unlawful, misleading, or harmful material.

6.title: Acceptable use
6.body: You may not attempt to bypass security, access another user's account, upload malicious files, scrape protected data, impersonate others, manipulate platform records without authorization, or use the platform for illegal activity.

7.title: No financial or legal advice
7.body: Sahmi does not provide investment, financial, tax, or legal advice. Users should independently assess project descriptions, projected returns, risk details, and dashboard information before making decisions.

8.title: Availability and liability
8.body: The platform is provided as available. Features may change, contain errors, or become temporarily unavailable. To the extent permitted by applicable rules, the project team is not responsible for losses resulting from reliance on platform data or unauthorized use.

9.title: Suspension and changes
9.body: Accounts or content may be restricted or removed to protect the platform, enforce these terms, or support operations. These terms may be updated as the platform evolves, with the latest version displayed on this page.

10.title: Contact
10.body: Questions about these terms may be sent to ikryyemala@gmail.com or directed to the Sahmi project team in Khan Yunis, Hounain Street, Gaza, Palestine.
